D: Good morning. What brings you in today?
P: I've been exhausted since the infection in March. By the afternoon I have to lie down.
D: Do you get headaches?
P: Yes, almost every day, mostly behind the eyes.
D: Any fever recently?
P: No, no fever at all.
D: Any palpitations?
P: Yes, in the evening, my heart races when I go to bed.
D: And chest pain?
P: No.
D: How is your sleep?
P: I wake up three or four times a night. And I forget words in the middle of a sentence, that never happened before.
D: Any cough or shortness of breath?
P: No cough. But I get out of breath on the stairs.
